Name: BulletAsylum
Description: A defence shooter about protecting a structure from everything falling on it.

Achievements.Name: Pew Pew
Achievements.Description: Shoot a total of 10,000 light gun bullets.

Achievements.Name: Blam Blam
Achievements.Description: Shoot a total of 3,000 heavy gun shots.

Achievements.Name: Zap Zap
Achievements.Description: Shoot a total of 1,000 laser bolts.

Achievements.Name: Stick It To 'Em
Achievements.Description: Use a single finger to reach Wave 10 in Arcade mode.

Achievements.Name: Sharpshooter
Achievements.Description: Get to Wave 3 in Arcade mode with an accuracy above 25%.

Achievements.Name: Sniper
Achievements.Description: Get to Wave 5 in Arcade mode with an accuracy about 40%.

Achievements.Name: Special Forces
Achievements.Description: Get to Wave 8 in Arcade mode with an accuracy above 50%.

Achievements.Name: Don't Cross the Streams
Achievements.Description: Build 4 lasers in Architect mode and fire them all at once.

Achievements.Name: Perfectly Efficient
Achievements.Description: Destroy 50 enemies at once with a single Overdrive blast.
